dedupe_keys.name: agencia portuguesa do ambiente drainage datasets

description: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente: drainage datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drainage; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Guia de orientação para a intervenção em linhas de água - ARH Centro; Cabo Verde Linhas de Água (DCW); Linhas de água com área drenante superior a 350 ha (3,5 km2). Formats seen: ZIP, PDF, WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
